{{Top|leg}}
The '''DeLuxe''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model produced by [[Carbanti United Electronics/Legends|Carbanti]].

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was offered a deal on a Carbanti DeLuxe with a supercharged hyperdrive unit in exchange for a scrapped [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], but he turned down the offer, despite a six-month guarantee in the case of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attacks.
